root_cause_analyses.root_cause: Thermal gradient during quench-hardening exceeded 180°C/min — residual tensile stress nucleated micro-crack.
root_cause_analyses.recommended_action: HALT production. 100% ultrasonic inspection of current batch. Adjust quench rate to ≤120°C/min.

root_cause_analyses.root_cause: Process parameter deviation detected — systematic drift in upstream station output.
root_cause_analyses.recommended_action: Isolate affected batch. Run statistical process control (SPC) chart analysis.

root_cause_analyses.root_cause: Chip re-cutting due to insufficient coolant flow; swarf re-entered the cutting zone.
root_cause_analyses.recommended_action: Increase coolant pressure to 60 PSI. Add air-blast chip evacuation. Re-inspect surface finish.
